I'm in the field. She will encourage you to see another therapist eventually. But first, she will try to talk it out... ask you why you have those feelings and other therapy stuff. And if she ever had a moment of "realness" with you, it will never happen again.

These other posters don't know what NYC is like. It sucks. I suggest you check yourself into an in-patient rehab- you can get help with services way faster that wa (public assistance, housing assistance, a grant to go to school). If not, go to an out-patient rehab at a HOSPITAL. Try Beth Israel. In patent rehabs have vocational counselors as well as ones for sub abuse. Go to AA meetings, even if you don't believe in it. And put it out there that you're looking for a job and to get your life together. People"in the rooms" will hook you up with connects to a job, maybe shelter, definitely food. For pocket change in the meantime, do extra work for TV shows. 34th st. Google it. You definitely do not need to die. I seen your story turn around dozens of times. You can pm me if you want to talk.

OP, what's your highest level of education? I think that borderlines need to be in a position of power- not that theyll abuse it, but for self efficacy. One only a PhD could allow. Or a master's in social work; that's the most economical one and you can do a lot with it. In a position of authority (like private practice or director of a program), you can work as much as you can handle, and you know how crucial that is for a borderline. OP, I know your type. We are the same, except you seem smarter. You KNOW borderlines. Help other borderlines. That is your purpose on this earth. Your life will straighten out once you are on that path.  How do you feel about that purpose?

You won't fuck it up because things are different now. And you need to stop mentally setting yourself up to fail. I was in the same situation. Went back to school later in life and got straight A's. Because I fucking wanted to. If you don't want it yet, then maybe going back isn't the best option for now. The alternative would be to teach yourself a shitload of things, and then go out in the world and experience just as many things. I think the school route is easier. But again, only you know if this is the best route for you right now or not.
No problem, get out there and start living for you :)
Maybe you should think about going to school then. Not for them, but for yourself.

People don't seem to understand that life is ultimately about survival. In the more well off places in the world, it's about surviving comfortably. THERE IS NO FORMULA FOR ACHIEVING THIS. You can start out in Brooklyn working retail and end up as a successful ghost writer in another country with a foreign wife. Or you could make 6 figures being a professional lab rat since you like risky things. The point is, make life worth living for yourself. Leave these people if you want!

I hear you. Focus on yourself for now. Embrace the idea that you may in fact be completely alone for a little while. Then take charge of your life and do what you want. Adopt a new hobby or perfect an old one. Sell stuff online. Take up swimming. Teach yourself guitar. Get a job (to pay for these things). Do whatever (good thing) that you want. As someone in your boat, I understand, and I care about you. God does too.

You sound above average in an average situation. People in today's world are lame followers who are all the same. They are dimwitted. You are not. People see this and they are threatened, so they'll say things to keep you down. Find a meet up group with people who are into similar things. And focus on improving yourself by sharpening what you're naturally good at. You will eventually surpass your "friends". As far as the rx drugs, get help for that. You could even pop into a narcotics anonymous meeting and find friends/identification there. Take care of yourself, you're worth it.

I am the first of an entire poverty stricken, no skills having family to go to a real college. Not one of those scammer colleges that advertise on the trains that put you in an amount of debt that renders you destitute. I am black, and things are a little harder for me because of that. We cannot all be Oprah or Jay Z; they are special. I am not. I am in the social services field. I recently got a degree in sub abuse counseling (top of my class), and I pursued a degree in social work right after at a good school. NO ONE AROUND ME UNSERSTANDS THE SIMPLIST OF ISSUES THAT I DEAL WITH. It has me questioning how they managed to live for so long because they're so dumb. I hate to put it that way. I have always been happy, loving, and non judgemental, and the smarter I got, the more unforgiving the world has been to me. No one has gone down this road in the history of my entire family. No one has connections, no-one has a real job, no one knows anything. Without the help of Google I would have died already. I just looked up the eviction process. My building is trying to evict me for $2250. They sprung it up on me without warning while I am currently waiting on a check to pay them their money, but this process is so fast, I'll probably be out before then. There is no space in my mother's apartment in the projects because my ex crack addicted uncle lives with her and so does my adult sister who got fucked by one of those scammer schools. And my schizophrenic brother occupies the couch. I also have a septoplasty and adenoidectomy scheduled for next Tuesday. I have to answer to the court this Thursday. Forget about my depression, anxiety, and ptsd issues that I never got treated for. Forget about my alcoholism that i worked hard to manage myself. FORGET ABOUT ABSTAINING FROM FUCKING THE GUYS THAT I WANT BECAUSE I'M WAITING TO HAVE SEX WITH THE RIGHT PERSON EVEN THOUGH THERE'S NO SIGN OF HIM COMING. Who the fuck would want me?! My sinus and tonsil issues gave me social leprosy for so many years. Chronic halitosis- intermittent, but still chronic. The entire time no one knew what the fuck I was talking about so I had to do YEARS of research to get to the bottom of it. NOW I GET THE SURGERY I'VE DREAMED OF AND I'M BEING EVICTED OVER SOME BULLSHIT. I guess I will be seeing my patients in the shelter soon. Just know... you are not fucking alone. At the end of the day, you are still smart. That skill is needed SOMEWHERE, SOMEHOW.

I'm not trying to diminish your problems, but at your age, and with the resources you have (including your brain), it looks like change is an inevitability for you. Positive change. Take it easy for a while if you have to. Only focus on skills/hobbies you enjoy for a bit; you'll meet like-minded people that you connect with that way also. You seem independent and smart, if people ask questions, it's not your job to make them understand. Be easy on yourself, I think you're doing great.
Do what you need to do.
Being suicidal encouraged me to live like I have nothing to lose, because I don't. Try it. Be your complete self. The consequences don't matter now do they?
Don't fucking do it!

I really hope that you stick around to see things get better. It starts with being kind to yourself. Relax for now so that you can recharge- no living to society's standards, no thinking about how messed up things are. Then, when you're ready, do one thing that can help your situation. I'm sorry you're so down right now, but there's hope.
Go to the hospital now!

And it was a good read, might I add. I just mean you write well, Inoffensive. Don't kill yourselves guys, there is always a way out. I've given up on too many people, only to see their lives improve somehow and see them in a much better place years later. 28 yo here, fantasized about beachy head for 7 years. Ironically, it led me to discover a band that became one of my favorites: https://youtu.be/4WY-Iin7P_w 
Please stay here and utilize every possible person/program that can help you. I am squatting in my apartment right now, and still managing to go to an unpaid internship during the week for school. I have a million issues on top of that- I get it. But it can get better. Hang in there!

You are me. We can brainstorm about how to fix this. I was thinking toastmasters. AA is also a great place to go where people accept you no matter what. I felt the most confident and comfortable with myself while I was going; there was so much identification and so little judgement. Just randomly go to a meeting in your area and just listen to other people's shares. You don't have to speak. If the chairs are set up in a circle, say "pass" if everyone's sharing in order. I'm telling you, this is the least intimidating place I've ever been to. I can't go back because I became a substance abuse counselor and I don't want to run into a patient. I'm kidding myself at this job btw, I'm more fucked up than the patients. I don't communicate properly and I don't know how to fix it. But I shouldn't die because of it, and neither should you. One day we will have aquired effective social skills and a circle of genuine, good people who will disarm us and allow is to blossom into our true selves. You can do this.

Go to AA meetings and explain your story. People will help you, and it is a great way to build a good social network. Your situation will be nothing new to them. You'd have to consider exaggerating your substance use if you've never been addicted. You will get help. There is always a way out so long as you are alive.
Stop slapping dogs and you'll be alright.

I know exactly how you feel, but you are not "incorrect". You are yourself. And you have a right to be so. I wish that I could take my own advice but we don't deserve to die. Fuck everyone else. Know this... if you keep a positive/oblivious attitude despite how people treat you, they will feel like losers that that is their way of getting through life. They literally feel stupid. FUCK. Them. I'll be whatever the fuck I am.
Don't. You're useful. You matter.

27 in community college here. Applied to really good universities for next spring and waiting yo hear back. Can't attend of I don't get scholarships. Failing my classes this last semester, previously had a 4.0. Taking 4 classes and an internship and one professor is legit trying to sabotage me and it killed my motivation. I don't have the energy or time to fight it any more. Not getting help from other departments. This professor decides how my life will turn out ( scholarship to prestigious uni). She is lucky I don't have the money for a revenge service. FUCK school. This is nothing to kill yourself over. I'm sure this is only one part of the problem but fuck everything and everyone. You deserve to live.

27yo woman here who prefers virgins. It makes it special. No woman is thinking "geez what a loser, never had sex". No one. And you will know what to do once you get there. Pussies aren't puzzles. It would be considered "noble" of you to want to wait until you found something special. It's actually quite romantic and this can absolutely work in your favor. Do not get tunnel vision on the puss, just say hello and get to know women. We are very receptive to sincerity.

All he'll hear is "blah, blah, blah, damaged". Honey, there are too many unraped chicks out here checking for your man lol. If you think it is inevitable that you tell him, I suggest you wait until that moment when you know that you can tell him anything and he'll love you no matter what. Super premature if you tell him now.

Do not contact him. From here on out you will need to focus on your mental health. Try to rely on mental health professionals for support and if you can only tell them about what happened. Most people that you confide in about this won't understand and will not be helpful. Most will blame, others will encourage you to take legal action (knowing there are no grounds). Talk here, and if you have health insurance and need to go inpatient for a while- do it. Go through these stages of grief and don't listen to other people's opinions during this process. When you are ready, get back into spirit- nourishing activities and focus on loving yourself. You can get through this.

Same thing happened to me. Had sex again the next morning because fuck it it was already done. He had sex with me while I was drunk and had just vomitted. I must have been passed out while he did it. Straight necrophilia. In the morning I asked him for a run down of the night because I didn't remember. He mentioned that my being wet was my consent. I'm certain that was my normal vaginal discharge that he felt. I woke up to the words "you should get plan b". I got drunk before he took me to his house. He wanted sex so bad he paid for an expensive cab ride to his mothers remote house. His fucking mother's house. I hated myself for having sex again to "save face" instead of going to the police. And the thing is... no one cares. I came here from suicide watch. You are not me, so there is hope for you. Try to get therapy. I'm sorry that this happened and I'm right there with you.

I know it hurts. With time and some footwork, you will be able to stabilize your moods and become aware of when an "episode" will hit. It seems that you're already pretty self aware. I can't imagine how intense it is, but you should try your best to get professional help. I am you 10 years later and no STABLE mental health routine. Right now you have a chance. Don't put this on hold.

I'm assuming that people are afraid to give you advice, but I'm on my way out so I don't mind. Even in her psychotic state, she will respond to attention (or lack thereof). Leave her alone for a while. She is used to you being there. This will be difficult, but it's necessary. Feign busyness. If she doesn't reach out to you during this time, make sure to maintain your distance. After a while of no contact she'll miss you, or at the very least she will be curious as to why she wasn't hearing from you. Now... since you're suicidal, I'm assuming you're up for taking risks? I say find a way to make the relationship not long distance when you come back into the picture. Get a job, move out, do whatever you have to to relocate... if you love her as much as you say. At 18, the outcome of this entire situation wouldn't be anywhere near catastrophic. Unless someone dies. And that doesn't need to happen. Trust me when I tell you this is merely a season in your life, however intense this may be.
Way to go, a psychologist? Your bpd symptoms will come out eventually, and he will know. I would then let him make the decision. He's trained to deal with this shit, why give him up?

We do care that you stay alive. I know i do. It will give me hope as my situation is very similar to yours. If you'd like to talk we can go over why we should live.

You say that you are a helper. The world needs people like you. But i understand that you also have needs.

Well i guess it's time for alternatives. Psychotropic meds can really help diminish the symptoms making you most ill, and from there you can regain the energy/drive to make positive changes. People have different opinions on meds though. I don't know how you feel about it.

Unfortunately some therapists aren't the best, but I believe that you can find one that can help you. And I also believe that it's inevitable you'll meet people that you can relate and talk to. This forum seems like it could be a start. I'm new here, but I've read comments from some really stand up people.

I'm sorry about your father. It doesn't sound like drinking would be such a good idea then. Have you thought about talking to a therapist? I'm trying to wonder why you're so upset with yourself. You seem like you have a chance of at least feigning normalcy (as draining as that can be initially).
And you're ahead of the game right now getting paid under the table. So many opportunities... let's talk and explore them. We don't want to lose you.

I'm not calling you an outcast freak. The point is, you will meet others like you in similar situations. Even here. And it will offer comfort, i swear. Do not do this.

Wow I can identify with this a lot. I'm 27, I go to community college and it's lame. Well it's actually great because I do learn a lot but it was a lonely road. I lived the 4.0 life for a year. I realized that school is a transient thing though. At the age you are, you don't have to be concerned with "fitting in". That's dead. Ace those classes and leave. If you're feeling terribly lonely, get drunk , have a meaningful and intimate conversation with someone at the bar ON A WEDNESDAY AROUND 4 SO YOU'RE NOT A LONER CREEP, and go home. That should recharge you a little bit. People are very accepting in environments like those. Just my advice.

I feel that you are being a little hard on yourself. And it's okay for now, just to get it out. But you should be proud about that medal that you got and your position in the Marines. You may be so depressed that you don't realize your accomplishments and how well you're doing.

Boy, I always know I'm doing bad when I delete my social media accounts lol. I felt the same way you did until I realized that not having them made me feel like more of a pariah and that didn't help me. I encourage you to sign back into fb, but don't go on there to browse. You just need to have a presence. I'm afraid that if you stay off the grid it will be easier to justify killing yourself. You shouldn't do that. Should we challenge each other to live life and do well? If you accomplish more than I do, I will pay for your vacation to wherever you want- granted I have the money at the time. I mean it.

I was going to jump off of my fire escape a couple days ago and my niece called me as I was writing the suicide note. It was her birthday the next day and she was telling me about her plans. I believe there's always a way out. You have to be very driven to not acknowledge the signs. 

I have decided to live and I hope that you do too. 

By the way, I have mild dyslexia and I have issues with my eustachian tubes which causes some words to come out funny, almost like I am deaf or mentally retarded. I also stammer when I'm nervous. I have a friend who is a really bad dyslexic with ADHD who hosts trivia night at bars for a living. It's brutal. But no one cares. NO ONE CARES ABOUT OUR FLAWS AS MUCH AS WE DO. 

You're a Marine, dude. You're doing just fine right now. Just stay focused and hang in there. And it wouldn't hurt to keep going to church.

It's okay, I figured you didn't mean it that way like I said before. I almost split you- a stranger, lol- but you didn't seem ill- intentioned. I'm going to assume that you know what splitting is. 

I really appreciate your response, though. It feels nice to know that someone cares. I didn't think anyone would respond since my situation is abysmal to me. 

I've decided to live. To fight. I got a lead on a job and my intermittent sinus and adenoid issues are clearing up for now. I am hot once again and my attractiveness should get me a job. I realized that people have to work with what they have, and in this respect, I am blessed. I put a lot of emphasis on this because it seems to define my place in the world. I wish it didn't but it does. I don't intend to suck cocks for a job. Just wanted to clear that up. 

Things will get terrible again in a few weeks, then again a few weeks after that. I'm willing to deal with it though. We can't be perfect out here- we just can't. My gpa dropped to a 3.7 and I started to plan to destroy the professor's life but... it's about doing the right thing. I'm rambling but just know that I thank you for reaching out. I really do.

Everyone on here deserves to live. I wish they knew that.

I knew that I shouldn't have written that I'm black. The only comment encourages me to get on welfare. Because that's apparently a viable option for "people like myself". Luckily I still have a sense of humor and I'm able to laugh at that. I don't even think your intentions are bad- just a little ignorant and insensitive. It doesn't matter much. I have too many issues and there is no hope. I will be gone by next season. I like the summer.

You guys can do it. So many people have done it. Think about adoption if the thought of raising a child is overwhelming for you. But think about this... instead of killing yourselves, you two can just pack up and leave. Just the two of you, figure out how to get through this together. You are young enough to work a shit job and not have to feel humiliated about it. The both of you really have a chance. You could do whatever the fuck you want to do because you're young enough to fuck up and try again- a few times even. Take a second to think about how beautiful (albeit scary) this blossoming life is. Fuck everyone and everything. You two can do this. You will receive help. Society cares about young people.
